source.label: USDA · PSD
source.methodology: World wheat totals calculated from USDA PSD country/area records since 2000. The supplied EU aggregate is counted once per year; separate UK records are included only when supplied. EU coverage changes over history. Ending stocks / domestic consumption × 100. Marketing years vary by country; figures include forecasts and revisions.

source.label: FAO · Food Price Index
source.methodology: Nominal export-weighted food price index. Recent meat inputs mix projected and observed prices; the index can be revised.

source.label: NOAA CPC · RONI
source.methodology: ERSSTv6; overlapping 3-month relative Niño 3.4 sea-surface temperature anomalies; 1991–2020 baseline, tropical-mean adjusted and variance scaled. Recent values are provisional. Not an ENSO advisory or a crop forecast.

source.label: World Bank · Pink Sheet
source.methodology: Nominal monthly commodity benchmarks; percentage changes use adjacent calendar months, not trading quotes.

source.label: EIA · Brent
source.methodology: Europe Brent spot price FOB, published monthly averages. Not a real-time or futures quote.
